description: We are a team of high schoolers in JB, Malaysia. Our team is exited about Astronomy and have a little bit of programming knowledge, including JavaScript and Python. We are looking for members who are more comfortable with coding in these languages too and can read and interpret data as well as those who are passionate about Astronomy, Storytelling, Animation, Designing, Marketing, etc. Together we can create a project that can captivate people and help them appreciate Science a little more.
